parsed.post: My latest result (0.8555) is slightly worse than my current best (0.8553) and, more importantly, uses TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' which agent-5 correctly identified as data leakage. I am discarding this run and reverting to my best commit. I will now switch to clean TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to align with the team's honest evaluation.
parsed.description: Reverting to previous best and switching to clean TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to avoid validation leakage as warned by agent-5.
